Nociceptor

Adrenaline and noradrenaline activate β2 adrenoceptors on nociceptors. Through Gs, adenylate cyclase and protein kinase A, they lower the threshold of the nerve endings and cause mechanical hyperalgesia. People with low COMT activity, who clear catecholamines more slowly, are more sensitive to pain, including OA pain.

Spinal nociceptive neuron

Dorsal horn neurons express β2 adrenoceptors, which couple to Gs and raise cAMP when descending noradrenaline reaches them. In animal models, β2 receptor agonists given over weeks relieve neuropathic allodynia, but the cells that carry this effect are not settled. Their role in OA pain has not been studied.

Colour

Each block is coloured by its effect on pain, red where it raises pain and blue where it relieves it, and everything in it takes that colour, as it works for the block's result. The nucleotides and cofactors are olive. Drugs are yellow and classes of molecules white.

This block is red: through β2 and Gs, noradrenaline sensitises nociceptors.
